source_policy: Original files, input hashes and native output receipts retained in the project; private scene/image data are not distributed with this plugin.
rgb_checks: Native mask shapes and crop bounds
No overlap or loss in pixel partition
Whole-crop denominator and numerator equal cell sums
Display grayscale does not change original RGB classification
vga_checks: Retained native depthmapX graph and CSV
No calculated centers inside selected buildings
All defined HH values checked from mean depth and graph size
Display crop and opacity leave source metrics unchanged
solar_checks: Three non-collinear native placements agree with saved frame
Recursive instance transforms and cached mesh readback
Ground receiving surfaces retain exposed negative courtyard levels
Solar positions checked against another ephemeris
Common receiver set and hour legend for both solstices
export_checks: Small legend with actual metric units
PNG and vector PDF retained separately from original calculations
Root delivery copies checked by hash
scope_limits: Classified RGB fraction is not NDVI
VGA is not pedestrian permission or observed flow
Sunlight is geometric exposure without cloud attenuation; absent context and excluded trees remain unmodelled
